evals.name: Fault-Tolerant Cache Service with Transparent DB Fallback
evals.prompt: Implement a resilient Redis cache service that reconnects with exponential backoff and transparently falls back to database queries during network outages.
evals.expected_output: Configures ioredis with retryStrategy and wraps cache operations in non-throwing try/catch guard blocks.
assertions: Configures exponential backoff retryStrategy in Redis client options
Catches connection exceptions without terminating active HTTP requests
Transparently falls back to primary database queries when Redis is unavailable
Applies explicit Time-To-Live (TTL) expiration on all cache set operations

evals.name: Visual Logging HTTP Interceptor & X-Cache Headers
evals.prompt: Author a NestJS HTTP cache interceptor that logs visual emoji indicators and injects X-Cache response headers.
evals.expected_output: Intercepts GET requests, computes MD5 cache keys, emits visual logs, and injects X-Cache: HIT/MISS headers.
assertions: Formats cache hits as '⚡ [CACHE HIT] GET /route (cached - Xms)'
Formats cache misses as '🔍 [CACHE MISS] GET /route (database query - Xms)'
Sets X-Cache response header to HIT on cached returns
Sets X-Cache response header to MISS on database pass-throughs

evals.name: Pattern-Based Cache Invalidation on Data Mutation
evals.prompt: Implement automatic cache invalidation for data mutation requests (POST, PATCH, DELETE) targeting related resource patterns.
evals.expected_output: Purges cached keys matching resource patterns upon successful write or mutation operations.
assertions: Intercepts POST, PATCH, PUT, and DELETE data modification requests
Purges matching Redis keys asynchronously after mutation succeeds
Emits visual confirmation log upon successful pattern invalidation
